subject.title: fix(gateway): archive legacy-root stale transcript files on reset/delete

question: Should reset/delete runtime archiving include raw stale paths under the canonical legacy global sessions root when realpath containment excludes outside-root and symlink escapes?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but it deliberately changes which local filesystem paths a reset/delete operation may rename.

options.title: Accept constrained runtime cleanup
options.body: Merge after confirming the legacy-root-only realpath guard is the desired runtime boundary for stale transcript cleanup.

options.title: Keep cleanup migration-only
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want legacy global transcript cleanup handled only by doctor or a store migration path.

recommendation.title: Accept constrained runtime cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the legacy-root-only realpath guard is the desired runtime boundary for stale transcript cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-state and rotation history makes this the best available owner for the filesystem-boundary choice.
